_what: The town's reachable region, measured against the BUILT navmesh from the PlayerStart by TRANSITIVE CLOSURE. Authored, versioned data -- not a diagnostic.
_method: Seeded with direct queries from the PlayerStart, then grown by RELAY from the nearest already-reachable row until a full pass recovers nothing. A single query is NOT sufficient: get_path_length has a finite search budget and returns FAIL when it exhausts it, which is not the same as 'no path exists'. The first version of this file made that error and understated street reachability by 136 rows.
_a_reachability_claim_is_true_for_ONE_na: If the agent, the bounds volumes or the terrain change, this file is stale and must be re-measured. It records the agent, the resident navmesh chunk count, the PlayerStart and the query extent it was measured with; the reachability module enforces the agent and (when the caller can supply it) the chunk count.
